action_needed: Dédalo now runs on Bun 1.4.5, a security release.
The Maintenance area now needs a profile grant — global administrators and developers with Maintenance at level 2, and the superuser.
Error reports are stored on your installation and sent by email; the anonymous report intake is removed.
A malformed DEDALO_MEDIA_WEB_BASE now stops the server from starting
Calculated fields: a formula definition must name the TypeScript engine and a `.ts` formula file; the earlier engine's definitions are refused
The old `filtered_by_search_dynamic` option filter is no longer read; a field that still relies on it alone is refused.
Publication fills the global search and map tables again
RDF publication produces real Linked Data (Nomisma).
SVG glyphs in text tags now resolve in lists and publications for vector components stored in sub-folders.
The "+" of a portal (and Duplicate, add term, the assistant) now needs permission to create in the target section.
A publication host in copy mode no longer answers "not found" for every published file.

entries.title: "Propagate component data now requires access to the section, not only to the field."
Record text shown by widgets and tools is always displayed as text; markup stored in a record no longer runs there.
Selects, radio buttons and check boxes offer only the options you may see, and the ones that fit the record.
A search through a linked record no longer matches links held in fields you cannot see in that record's section.
Automatic translation cleans rich text exactly like a normal save
Thesaurus and ontology tree terms are always shown as text; markup typed into a term no longer runs.
The References panel and related-record lists show only the columns the user may read.
The "+" of a portal (and Duplicate, add term, the assistant) now needs permission to create in the target section.
Graph labels and the thesaurus indexation list show only what the user may read.
The transcription print feed now checks the section, the transcription field and every note it shows.
Info widgets are computed only for users who may read the widget's section and component.
Exports no longer include linked records outside your projects.
CSV import buttons use the tool's colour
Publication field keeps its switch in the time machine preview
Time machine buttons use the tool's colour
File drop zone uses the tool's colour
The Stop button of a running process shows a stop icon.
"Activating or repairing a hierarchy links its root term only when it is unambiguous — the one term without a parent — and keeps every valid root."
"Importing URIs as JSON: a property the URI field does not know is refused by name, the URL loses its surrounding spaces, and an empty item is refused."
"A field placed inside a `box elements` container of the ontology is no longer treated as a field of its section — deleting a record's data leaves it, and searches and lookups ignore it, as in v6."
A term added from the thesaurus tree is no longer marked descriptor and indexable automatically.
"Zotero import: a whole-number call number is the record number — checked, and refused when it would overwrite another reference."
"Zotero import: the highest record number is the only limit of a call number, a Zotero key is checked in the whole section, and you are warned about a record you may not change."
"Zotero import: a record taken over by a reference is listed apart, and a reference without a Zotero key that names another reference's record is refused with an explanation."
Exported text cells no longer carry the editor's tag marks.
Zenon search results show author names without the role labels.
An image's file name (the `image_id` field) must be unique in its section and cannot be changed while the image's files exist; a duplicate gets its own file name.
A selected value you may not see, or that no longer fits the record, now shows as *(restricted)* instead of vanishing.
An open-ended Id range means what it says — `5...` is every id from 5 up, `...5` every id up to 5, and `...` alone is an empty input.
Translate all languages no longer offers the Local AI translator; Translation keeps it.
"Zotero import: an export over 64 MB is refused."
Media versions: the thumb opens in the tool's preview, like the other qualities.
Search-as-you-type keeps the previous results on screen while it looks for the new ones, and answers sooner.
Search-as-you-type in a field that links to many sections answers several times faster.
A record that points at a term from a section you cannot read shows its section name and id, in the edit form, in panels and in exports.
The export tool scrolls to the download buttons when an export finishes.
The user's record filter list can be searched and sorted.
IRI labels follow their IRI's permission; Time Machine notes belong to the change they annotate.
The Ontology and Thesaurus trees are now usable on phones and tablets.
On a phone, a list can be turned to the next page from its end.
Lists show the section's identifying colour, as the edit form does.
Thesaurus and ontology tree searches can now step through the found terms.
A field's search options now explain the search operators, with a sample for each and what it finds.
Exports can include the calculated relations of a related-terms column, in a column of their own.
Users see their own activity statistics in their profile.
The map field shows the common unsaved-changes line, and its reload and add-point icons have tooltips.
Menu bar items vertically centred when an instance colour is set
Searching a number in an autocomplete whose fields include the record id no longer fails.
Tool permissions list keeps its size on activation and highlights checked tools
On a phone, the record graph view stacks the graph above the record panel.
On a phone, the Id header of each record card lines up with the rest of the card.
On a phone, a long menu can be scrolled to its last entries.
On a phone, the top bar's buttons are finger-sized and line up.
On a phone, the list edit and delete-record dialogs fit the screen.
Escape closes a dialog while typing in a text field.
On a phone or touch screen, the thesaurus tree is easier to tap.
On a phone, the multi-language tool's controls fit the screen and each language is set apart.
The JSON editor's indent guides are readable in the dark theme.
"An audiovisual record without a stored duration shows its measured duration, or nothing — no longer an invented 00:00:00."
An audio/video upload is refused while a version of the same file is still being built.
Choosing a data language the installation does not have is refused.
"The text fragments of the indexation grid show their images on installations that serve media from a separate address, and a cut fragment never ends in half a tag mark."
"A refused language change no longer clears open sections or leaves the selector on the refused language."
Labels and defaults follow the language you chose, not the installation's.
Sorting a list by a translatable field follows your data language.
"A field that points to a list shared between installations (yes/no and the other common lists) no longer offers non-root users the buttons to open or edit that list's records."
A link that opens a single field now shows it in the right language.
"The tooltip of a component's state icon (an alternative or deprecated field) shows readable text in your language, naming the field it points to — no longer a label key."
"The state widget's edit options now show in the data language you chose."
A thesaurus term missing in your language now shows in another of your project languages, marked as untranslated, and shows every value it holds.
"A record recovered from the Time Machine no longer stays in the list of deleted records, and the section's list opens again without its old search."
"Tool names and help texts missing in the interface language fall back to its declared equivalent language (Valencian shows Catalan) instead of English."
The Local AI translator no longer loses, reverses or invents marks silently
Searching through a field without its own configuration uses the same columns as its list.
A field's dataframes are the same set when it is shown, saved, restored and exported.
Search filter chips past the first page show their labels.
An empty text area shows the other language's text as plain text, and list previews load their images from the media server.
Uploading a very large file no longer fails while the server is still assembling it.
Videos on some servers no longer show a 2-second duration in the edit view and the versions tool.
Reverting a batch run cleans the values it puts back like a normal save
"CSV import: a record number above the limit skips only its row."
A field opened in fullscreen from the ontology or thesaurus tree fills the screen again.
Fullscreen fields show their tools in every active-field style; Lift joins a portal's search bar to its card.
The Lift active-field style no longer hides its tools or overlaps the ontology tree.
The ontology window opened from a Children/Parent row now always shows and highlights the term.
The thesaurus picker under a field lines up with it and fits a phone screen.
Parent and Children columns in lists read as one line again.
Restoring a version from the Time Machine cleans the value like a normal save
Local AI translation no longer reports success when the translation could not be saved
A CSV too large to import is refused when it is uploaded, and the import panel shows why a staged file cannot be read
A CSV the import tool cannot read now shows as a card you can delete.
Escape now leaves a text area or JSON field, as it does every other field.
An empty Zenon field no longer shows a blank column.
Long words in narrow list columns no longer spill over the next column.
Regenerating a media file now restores its original file name the same way from both tools.
Creating or duplicating a record that would link to a deleted record is refused.
Sorting a list by a number column orders the values numerically (2, 9, 10), not as text (10, 2, 9).
Changing or clearing the person of a biographical milestone clears the milestone again.
Searching the ontology or a thesaurus no longer stops working until the page is reloaded.
Long values in search-form autocomplete fields are readable again.
Select options with a dataframe no longer end in a stray separator.
Transcription tag statistics count the interview's own-language text
Transcriptions show again, in blue, the tags whose pair or indexation is broken.
A text area whose translation was emptied shows the other-language text in lists too.
The thesaurus and ontology search panels list each field once, and offer every field any of your hierarchies lets you read.
Calculated fields (totals, periods, amounts, date sums) compute again
An emptied translation shows the other-language text again
Searching or sorting through a link to external records no longer fails or matches the wrong record.
Deleting a record's data no longer empties fields its section hides.
A duplicated record's image opens in the edit view again, with its drawing layers.
JSON and geolocation columns are no longer blank in exports.
Exported text cells read as plain text — paragraphs become line breaks, HTML entities are decoded.
Images named by their "Filename" field open, upload and regenerate under that name again.
Relation fields without their own configuration show their linked records in the view the ontology asks for (e.g. mini, text).
Linking to a record that was just deleted is now refused instead of leaving a broken link.
Archive weight statistics and coins-by-period counts are correct again
The posterframe tool offers identifying images for records of virtual sections, and creates them through portals whose target is set only in their configuration.
The thesaurus “Parent” field no longer offers a “new record” button.
Sorting a list by a number or JSON column orders by its value again.
Layout-only panels (`section_group_div`) render again without a header.
An open-ended Id range (5... or ...5) in search no longer returns every record.
A select with a dataframe (such as the uncertainty of a coin's discovery method) shows and saves its frame again.
Thesaurus labels drawn from a linked term, a list value or the record id are no longer blank or truncated.
Time Machine keeps the previous value on the first edit of imported data.
Search filters and user-activity statistics no longer fill the Time Machine
The thesaurus tree shows the equivalence (EQ) icon on both terms of an equivalence, not only on the one where it was entered.
Search, export and cache-update field lists no longer offer obsolete field types.
Zotero import works again — CSL JSON exports, PDFs and cover images are imported.
Exports now include the records that point at each record (the Relations field), instead of an empty column.
Export and search can pick fields from every section a field points to, not only the first.
Exports in the Standard format follow each column's configured fields and separators, and relation columns that came out blank now carry their values.
Importing a URI with a label now saves the label, and a text label is found or created.
A Word or OpenDocument file uploaded to a PDF field is no longer published as its PDF.
Uploading a PDF fills its transcription field again, and the OCR option works.
The Indexations field of a thesaurus term shows the columns of the records that point at it.
The `=` exact-match search now ignores letter case, so `=vic` finds "Vic".
SVG glyphs in text tags now resolve in lists and publications for vector components stored in sub-folders.
Date fields inside portal rows no longer stack their buttons
Emptying a record's data no longer moves it out of your project.
The close (×) button of a field inside a list row shows only while that field is hovered or active.
Open relationships dialog no longer jumps when switching scope
A record edited in its own window now shows the saved value in the list or field that opened it.
A refreshed portal shows its values normally, with their separators.
Related-records columns show their values in lists and in the record history.
The References panel and delete dialogs show the columns of thesaurus terms and other virtual sections again.
Profiles: the permissions tree uses the full width and reads well on phones.
Restoring a Time Machine version that equals the current value no longer adds history.
Translation tool: Copy to target works again; panes fill the window and fit narrow screens
The multi-language tool's **Automatic translation** works: it offers the same engines as the single-language tool.
The transcription print tool shows why it cannot open instead of staying blank.
A portal no longer refuses to refresh when one of its target sections is closed to you.
Saving a hierarchical autocomplete on a duplicated record no longer fails with "cannot delete path in scalar".
Fields whose value holds an empty object no longer look edited when they are not.
Exporting a related field no longer refuses what the record already shows you.
Refreshing a map with drawn points no longer throws errors or loses its layer control.
Records linked from the list's link button no longer store the stray `close_modal` key in their locator.
The ontology tree shows each node's model name once, not twice.
Link resource now works from a component opened inside the Ontology or Thesaurus tree.
A portal's "Link resource" picker now saves every pick, and unlinks too.
Reloading a record's edit page keeps the record's place in its search results.
Saving a profile's access permissions no longer reports an error on slow connections when the save went through.
Opening a term in a new tree window now jumps straight to it and keeps it in view.
The Maintenance area now needs a profile grant — global administrators and developers with Maintenance at level 2, and the superuser.
The `root` password can no longer be changed from inside the application
Error reports are stored on your installation and sent by email; the anonymous report intake is removed.
An external service's API addresses are no longer sent to the browser, and may not carry a query string
Maintenance mode now closes every route to non-root sessions, not only the API
The server unit runs on a read-only file system; the installer upgrades its own earlier templates and the update names the re-render command.
The installer verifies every ontology file against its source's digest; long boots are no longer restarted by the watchdog; the server unit runs sandboxed.
The Docker stacks now pin PostgreSQL, nginx, certbot, MariaDB and pgvector to an exact version and digest.
The Hierarchy tool's "Force to create" only rebuilds a hierarchy's own ontology, and deleting a hierarchy record no longer uninstalls an ontology it does not own.
The setting TOOLS_REGISTRY_CACHE_TTL_MS is removed.
The old `filtered_by_search_dynamic` option filter is no longer read; a field that still relies on it alone is refused.
The "recovery mode" switch is gone; a damaged ontology is now repaired from the command line.
The PDF viewer is updated to pdf.js 6.5.438.
Dédalo now runs on Bun 1.4.5, a security release.

"Installing a publication host is easier: the guided install handles IPv4 + IPv6 and redirect virtual hosts, Enter takes ordinary defaults, the panel prints the one-server install, and the public check accepts an http address that moves to https."
"The activity log no longer records actions on the search presets being edited, on the Time Machine itself or on the daily activity statistics."
A denied area now hides everything under it, in the menu and in the profile permissions.
"The data-language sync setting is now called DEDALO_DATA_LANG_SYNC, as in v6."
"The language settings now all carry their v6 DEDALO_ names."
A text field cleared in every language is stored as absent, not as an empty item.
The Update-code panel says when the database's data version blocks a code update
The Update-data panel's "Not updated" notice is shown in your language
Accounts still on a v6 password are counted at start, and the log names the command that fixes them
A malformed DEDALO_MEDIA_WEB_BASE now stops the server from starting
Calculated fields: a formula definition must name the TypeScript engine and a `.ts` formula file; the earlier engine's definitions are refused

A publication aggregate table whose column mapping names a column that exists nowhere is refused at validation instead of being silently left out; a column only a table alias carries is filled by the alias.
The image updater brings the stack's PostgreSQL, nginx, certbot, MariaDB and pgvector up to the release's pins — and refuses a new database major, which is a migration.
Information fields export every widget, the user-activity widget included; they are computed-only fields the cache and the CSV import leave alone.
Published information fields carry the readable value the record page shows (a duration as text, not its internal object); on-demand widgets are published too.
"MARC21 import: a conditional rule with no matching copy writes nothing, and a rule can join every repetition of one field (`occurrences: \"all\"`)."
Database statements slower than five seconds are now logged by default.
A section whose term names a component the engine cannot render as text now fails loudly instead of showing blank labels.
A request now waits at most 30 seconds for a free database connection by default.
A database statement of ordinary request traffic is now stopped after one minute by default.
The Local AI translator offers a choice of pinned models
The ontology check names alias components that point at a component they cannot stand in for.
Maintenance lists the records that lack a field's default value; the manual states when a default is written.
Every conversion of v6 passwords is recorded in the activity log
Accounts still on a v6 password can be converted from the Maintenance area
Permission matrices and record filters can be exported.
The ontology status panel names URL components that are wrongly marked as translatable
Ontology update list can open full screen.
The publication host draft form can set a custom site home.
An installation can now be given its own colour, so several installations open side by side can be told apart.
"A failed download of the IP-to-country database no longer stops the server while it starts."
Maintenance map panel fits a phone screen.
"Diffusion: a `text_format` pattern no longer strips a leading `/` (or other separator) from the value itself."
"Diffusion: a value MariaDB refuses names the record instead of stopping the run with an unexpected error."
"Diffusion writes the `publication_schema` table again, so `resolve_inverse_relations=true` works on v7 publications."
A code update renames retired configuration keys itself instead of failing.
"lg-nolan can no longer be configured as the working data language."
"Publication: a relation's `empty_value` keeps every item's place, and a field's frames publish only for the main field they belong to."
Diffusion elements excluded in the tool configuration are hidden and refused again.
"Publication: the Download button of a file publication's report works when media is served from another address."
"Publication: a table's `is_publishable` setting is honoured in every publication run."
"An information field observing another field now recomputes on the records its `server.config` names."
The command-line MCP server answers in its account's languages.
The profile permissions no longer offer fields that are not part of the section.
"Thumbnails in similar-object, identification and characterisation results follow the media web address."
"The References panel no longer opens a column for a section, the exclude marker or the old security field."
A link to the Ontology area no longer opens a page that then refuses
"The process-state widget now follows a multi-step path to its state field."
After logging in as the superuser you land on the Maintenance area again.
"Update cache brings old stored formats up to date: legacy time codes in text areas and JSON stored as text."
A relation list that names two sections resolves to the last one, and never shows a section as a column.
Login reads an empty or malformed stored password the same way everywhere
A node with two children of one model always resolves to the first by order.
The Update data panel speaks the administrator's language throughout
A damaged server state file now keeps maintenance mode on instead of silently switching it off
Starting v7 on a Dédalo v6 database now says the database is not migrated
A system search across two or more linked sections no longer matches through a record stored in another table.
Published bibliography columns that read from Zenon now carry their values.
A publication run no longer empties a record's remote (Zenon) values when the remote service is down: the record is held back, reported, and retried by the next run.
A published geolocation column places an area or a route at one representative point instead of publishing the whole outline under the longitude.
The release-archive install has a worked example, and `install.sh` says what `--release-sha256` takes.
The installer says a checkout, instance or database is already installed on the System check or the Database screen, not after the Review.
Published RDF writes dates, years, integers and booleans in the standard XSD form, so the documents validate (a year -25 is written -0025).
An RDF property over a relation list may narrow the referencing records by section and by linking field (its `config`); such elements compile again.
A Tools configuration record that points a picker tool at another section lets that section's records be linked.
Publishing hierarchies and text-area geolocation fields no longer reports errors and leaves empty columns.
Publication fills the global search and map tables again
Information fields (calculated widgets) are published and exported with their current value.
A new installation's first update no longer rebuilds every search index.
MARC21 import reads its field map from the Tools configuration and applies every mapping rule and the Values form.
Number fields are now stored with the type and decimals their definition declares, whichever way the value arrives.
RDF publication produces real Linked Data (Nomisma).
The activity-log and publication-ledger retention prunes now run in small committed batches.
A tool configuration record can again redefine which components a tool uses on one field or button.
Update cache now recomputes external portals instead of reporting a false success.
A failed code-only or same-version update now puts the previous code back by itself.
The **Latest changes** list in a profile's permissions shows the ontology updates again.
The login page now opens in the installation's default interface language.
Profile tool permissions list is readable on a phone.
A publication host in copy mode no longer answers "not found" for every published file.
Publication host install accepts passwords with accented letters (ñ, ç, ü…) and any language's letters.
Saving a field of a record that does not exist (or was deleted) is refused instead of creating the record.
A refused maintenance action now shows the server's reason in the panel, not only a generic sentence.
A tool's window size and position are read as data, never run as code
A field with no sortable value (links, IRIs, media, access rules, passwords) can no longer be used to sort a list.
"The install seed can be built from an ontology master's latest release — from the command line or the maintenance panel."
"Publication API v2: fulltext search takes `lang`."
Tools can open attached to their component, with no modal or window.
"An element's `properties.label` lang map now replaces its label in the edit and list contexts, chosen through the same language fallback as every ontology label."
A component whose list configuration names no section now reads from the caller's own section.
"Publication API v2: AV fragments on a database without the AV tables answer 400, not 500."
"Publication API v2: `resolve_inverse_relations=true` on a database without a `publication_schema` table answers 400, not 500."
"Publication API v2: range filters compare numbers as numbers, so BC dates work."
Object identification's grouping run refuses a language the installation does not have.

"A tool's `affected_tipos` honours its declared wildcard (`test*` = every element of that TLD) and regular-expression entries, and a tool restricted to a mode (`properties.mode`) only shows in that mode."
"A tool's availability check receives the real section and mode of the element it is offered on; inside Time Machine (dd15) only the export tool is offered."
